'''The Kyryll's World system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]. It contained the planet [[Kyryll's World/Legends|Kyryll's World]], homeworld of the [[Pui-ui]] species.
